title: TableList
description: Partial projection of the metadata for a given table in a list response.

etag.description: A hash of this page of results.

labels.description: The labels associated with this table. You can use these to organize and group your tables.

creationTime.description: Output only. The time when this table was created, in milliseconds since the epoch.

requirePartitionFilter.description: Optional. If set to true, queries including this table must specify a partition filter. This filter is used for partition elimination.

expirationTime.description: The time when this table expires, in milliseconds since the epoch. If not present, the table will persist indefinitely. Expired tables will be deleted and their storage reclaimed.

friendlyName.description: The user-friendly name for this table.

id.description: An opaque ID of the table.

useLegacySql.description: True if view is defined in legacy SQL dialect, false if in GoogleSQL.

nextPageToken.description: A token to request the next page of results.

totalItems.description: The total number of tables in the dataset.
